coverage_policy: full composites require the maximum main16x32 q-2 event and pair support; history composites allow axes with at least 50 main16x32 events and report reduced support
external_confirmation: grid50x8; previously seen corpus, not a pristine holdout
matched_control: same task, scene, and absolute query; neither loop nor static
